# Longword char-granularity break (W2 residual)

The word below is wider than one line, forcing a character-granularity break.
Highlight `ZEBRA59` (line before the long word), then highlight the FIRST
line of the long word and, separately, the SECOND line of it — the two
highlight rects pin exactly where the device breaks inside the word.

ZEBRA59 marks the line before the long word.

MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM
